objective: Identify whether newly released 2026 full-duplex families deserve German-first local VPS execution before downloading large weights or opening a Trigger4 integration lane.

observations.reason: Plug-and-play streaming semantic state/VAD organ is attractive for low-latency turn taking and interruption control, but current official model/eval metadata is English/Chinese. Do not spend VPS model-download/runtime budget on a German production claim without new German evidence or a German adaptation experiment.

observations.observed_weight_footprint: approximately 25.6 GB model repository before Token2Wav companion weights
observations.runtime_requirements_observed: CUDA/vLLM/FlashAttention; default deployment separates Token2Wav and backend across GPUs, single-GPU supported with reduced memory budget
observations.reason: Strong architecture reference for native full-duplex speech, but German is not an official language target and the released 13B BF16 + vocoder GPU stack is not the highest-information use of the current VPS.

observations.license_observed: GLM-4-Voice-derived custom license; academic research free, commercial registration/conditions apply
observations.runtime_requirements_observed: CPU smoke path exists; real-time full-duplex recommended on GPU
observations.reason: Native simultaneous listen/speak/interruption control is architecturally relevant, but no reviewed primary evidence establishes German quality and its real-time path is GPU-oriented. License is also less frictionless than Apache-2.0 candidates.

cross_family_result.highest_value_donor: SoulX-Duplug turn-taking/state-prediction architecture because it is only 0.6B and separable from the speech/LLM identity plane
cross_family_result.reason: Trigger7 is German-first. None of the three reviewed families currently supplies source-level evidence sufficient to justify German production promotion, and two are materially GPU-heavy. Preserve them as architecture/research donors and re-open only on German evidence, smaller/runtime-compatible release, or a dedicated adaptation hypothesis.

negative_evidence: English/Chinese benchmark or model metadata does not imply German capability.
Native full-duplex architecture quality does not imply F2 state/tool/memory ABI compatibility.
CPU smoke-testability does not imply realtime CPU viability.
Upstream demos do not grant German E2E, acoustic, runtime, Trigger4 or whole-product credit.
next_exact_action: Keep the three families on a low-cost watch list rather than executing them now. Highest-value executable Trigger7 work remains the existing local modular/HF lanes once their current semantic authority gates permit classification; independently re-open SoulX-Duplug if a German checkpoint/eval or a bounded German adaptation experiment becomes available.
